name: project-midgardia
description: An original, private multiplayer 2D RPG foundation inspired by classic PC MMORPG interaction patterns.

scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && pnpm db:push && pnpm db:seed && concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @midgardia/client dev" "pnpm --filter @midgardia/server dev"
scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @midgardia/client build && pnpm --filter @midgardia/server build
